versions.content: If a node of the J1939 Network Management module is configured for immediate online state ( J1939NmNode StartUpDelay disabled) , its NodeChannels shall enter the state ‘NormalOperation’ immediately after the switch from ‘SleepMode’ to ‘NetworkMode’ . The J1939 Network Management module shall report this state change to the Basic Software Mode Manager via BswM_J1939Nm_StateChangeNotification (NM_STATE_NORMAL_OPERATION ) .
